metadata.description: Simple Drawing Pad: sketch an idea by hand with a graphics tablet, mouse or touch screen and let Claude look at it.

plugins.name: simple-drawing-pad
plugins.description: Sketch an idea by hand and let Claude look at it. Run /simple-drawing-pad:install once on each Windows computer, then press Ctrl+Alt+D to open the drawing window (with a graphics tablet, the whole tablet is your drawing area). Use Ctrl+V to paste it in the chat. Simple as that.
